notes:
v4.6.32 — Broker-isolated bot data + IBKR 'not connected' fix

🐛 FIXED — IBKR overview showed a bogus 100% loss
• In IBKR mode the per-bot blocks read the Alpaca account's lifetime history but found no IBKR equity, computing (0 − prior)/prior = −100% and even writing a 0-equity snapshot that corrupted the Alpaca baseline.
• Now: when a broker isn't connected (IBKR with no reachable gateway, or Alpaca with no keys) the block shows a neutral 'not connected' state — no fake −100%, no snapshot written.

🗂️ SEPARATE DATA FILES PER BROKER — run the same bot on BOTH brokers
• Each bot now keeps its trade log, equity/lifetime history and day-state in a per-broker folder, so e.g. the LONG bot tracks Alpaca and IBKR P/L completely independently.
• Alpaca keeps its existing flat file layout untouched (no history loss / no migration); IBKR and any other broker get their own data folder.
• Bot subprocesses are told their broker so live trades record into the right broker's files.

ℹ️ What's shared across Alpaca & IBKR: credits, universes, Make-Bot, Friends, and Admin. Everything else (bot lists, overview, per-bot tabs, Tools/keys, manual trading) is broker-specific.

Note: actually EXECUTING trades through IBKR (vs reading its data) is still in progress — built-in bots currently trade via Alpaca.
